title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot (Writing Assistance) gains enterprise data protection
summary: Hold: the briefing describes licensing as unpublished even though Microsoft documents the Copilot Chat subscription prerequisite. Its repeated claim that the current roadmap still carries a March 2026 release pause is also unsupported by the supplied record. The notice's rollout window, default state and documented Edge policy details are supported.

claims.quote: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers.
